cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government contract with a foreign provider carries terms on data jurisdiction, portability, exit or source code. The national hosting fact covers the identity database only.
cells.note: The CBN data localisation rule is in force and NIMC states the national identity database is hosted and run in Nigeria (NGA-024), so stage 4. Stage 5 needs a contract carrying data terms, and none is held.
